experiment: Exp 78 — seeded ancestor on the book economy (restored genesis_lab.py)
finding: The restored engine runs end-to-end (blocker resolved). The hand-designed ancestor earns EXACTLY ZERO energy on the book economy: 0/1561 alive ticks had a positive energy delta. It pays a real, continuous metabolic cost (median 161 energy/tick) and starves at ~tick 1563-2161. It fills all 32 CAM working-memory slots, so the reward-gated write/STDP learning signal fires — but that signal is DECOUPLED from metabolic income: the organism can memorise associations yet cannot convert reading into energy. This is a direct, measured confirmation of the Rule 21.1 metabolic-ceiling claim (real cost > real income).
